name: Ordered Doom
description: Strike with a doom that has been put in order so that the blow falls in the place the hour has set aside for it.

name: Turning Lot
description: Draw a sheltering lot over the user so that the hour holds back its worst blows.

name: Hour Prospect
description: Read the written lines of the near hour and know what stands ahead before it is lived.

name: Luck Restored
description: Restore the luck of an ally or the self to its better line so that grave wounds close along the way.

name: Threadbare Fate
description: Wear a foe's fate threadbare until their every act is slowed by the thinness of what remains.

name: Rebounding Doom
description: Rebound a doom upon the caster by turning the thread of it back along the hour it came by.

name: Pivotal Strike
description: Strike at the pivot on which the foe's hour turns so that harm passes through every defense.

name: Life Rewoven
description: Reweave the broken thread of an ally whose breath has just stopped before the short window of the hour closes.

name: Hour Thread
description: Bind a foe to a single thread of the hour so that they can act only as that thread allows.

name: Written Ruin
description: Write a ruin into the next breath of the field so that every foe within meets it as written.

name: Rewritten Lot
description: Rewrite the lot of a single exchange after it is cast so that the blow falls where it had not been drawn to fall.

name: Penned Calamity
description: Pen a calamity into the hour so that it falls upon the whole field at the full destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Written Hour
description: Write the next hour of a single foe and it comes to pass exactly as written; no cultivation energy mechanic explains why their every act obeys the line and its use is a consequence event.

name: Unwritten Strike
description: Strike where no line of the hour has yet been written so that nothing in the foe's guard has been prepared for it.

name: Vacant Ward
description: Hold a ward on which no doom has been written so that no doom can find a place to stand.

name: Foreseen Ending
description: Read how a coming fight is likely to end and which turns may still change that ending.

name: Renewed Fate
description: Begin the fate of an ally or the self again from a healthier line so that grave harm eases.

name: Ending Withheld
description: Withhold the ending that was about to fall on the user and let the blow be nullified.

name: Fate Bargain
description: Strike a bargain with fate for the user and nearby allies that lifts every strike and guard for a time.

name: Last Edict
description: Pass an edict that closes a foe's paths of action to a single narrow one.

name: Resurrected Thread
description: Take up the thread of an ally whose breath has just failed and tie it back before the short window closes.

name: Open Ending
description: Leave the foe's ending open so that they cannot count on any outcome and their resolve flags.

name: Ending Imposed
description: Impose a fitting ending on a single exchange so that it concludes as the user chooses.

name: Fate Unchained
description: Unchain the fates of all in the field from their paths so that chance runs wild among them.

name: Ending Descending
description: Bring the ending down on the whole field at the full destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Unwritten Ending
description: Erase the written ending of one being so that no outcome is fixed for them; no cultivation energy mechanic explains why nothing they do can then succeed or fail until the user lets it be written again and its use is a consequence event.

name: Fate Unmade
description: Strike a being out of fate itself so that none can foretell or affect their end; no cultivation energy mechanic explains the removal and its use is a consequence event.
